verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud infrastructure/IaaS provider (instance provisioning, clusters, storage, Slurm/K8s), not an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes MCP servers as tools. The only MCP-related evidence is an unofficial third-party MCP *server* that lets external agents control Lambda instances — that's Lambda being used as a tool target, not Lambda acting as an MCP client plugging in tools, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product type.
